page.layout: One page of verse, one column. Heading at top centre with a subtitle line beneath it. Below, the poem in italic lines, with a woodcut initial Q at the start. No marginal notes. A handwritten page number at top right and a handwritten "b" at lower right are not printed and are left out.

main_text.head: MARIA MORTI PROPINQVA maritum mœstum consolatur.

p.i: QUid miseram tanto gemitu lacrymisq; fatigas Vita care mihi Princeps mage, vita manebat Dum mihi? sicne tuam extremo sub tempore vita Iamdudum vario turbatam pectora luctu, Hoc etiam exerces Mariam Friderice dolore? Sunt acres mihi, quas memoras iusto ordine, curæ Sunt satis, imprimis sed quæ nunc maxima natu Filia, dilecti deplorat vincla mariti, Et tremula patrem qui lugent voce nepotes, In tristi renouant semper mihi corde tumultum. Ne mihi, ne lacrymis curas augeto priores Mi Friderice tuis, iamdudum hic omnia luctus Plena, & funereis resonat tua questibus aula Iamdudum satis, hic lacrymis, hic terminus esto. Quid frustra tanto iuuat indulgere dolori? Desine me nimijs affligere, teq; querelis. Sat patriæ, Mariæq; tuæ Friderice dedisti, Sat tua, sat tanto pietas perspecta dolore.

Me si fata tuis tecum considere terris Amplius, & gnatis vellent superesse tibiq;, Effœtum iusto recreassent robore corpus, Et vigor amissus labefacta in membra redisset Iampridem, ac tardi cessissent tædia morbi. Nunc aliter Christo visum: nam cernis atroci Victa malo membra ut nequeat medicina iuuare, Inq; dies crescat duri violentia morbi. Languida iam sicco vix hæret lingua palato, Infirmoq; animam vix hanc in corpore duco.

page.notes: The first word has a woodcut Q initial, read as "Quid". Some line-start marks ("vita", "vario", "vita" in line 3 and other places) are small ornaments or abbreviation marks that are hard to read; the printed form may differ. The subtitle is a second line of the heading. The handwritten "156" at top right and the handwritten "b" at lower right are not printed text and are omitted.
